latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Image to Video Luma — Animate Images into Video Clips.

- Animate still images into 1080p MP4 video clips using Luma AI with simple prompts.
- Supports quick upload of JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC files (up to 20MB); ready-to-post outputs in about 30–90 seconds.
- Includes easy session setup, free token onboarding, and guided user prompts for common workflows.
- Offers features for credit checking, video export, editing instructions, and timeline state preview.
- Designed for creators, marketers, and social media managers who want fast, AI-driven image animation without technical setup.
